narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal travel vlog update where the creator shares his frustration and regret over not booking a return flight in advance. He illustrates the severity of domestic travel demand in Taiwan by showing his long wait in the standby area of an airport terminal, ultimately advising viewers to book their tickets as early as possible to avoid similar situations.
